product_summary: Dhatu Organics & Naturals Pvt Ltd (Mysuru, Karnataka; store/plant at R176, 6th Main, Hebbal Industrial Estate, Mysore 570016) runs a 269-SKU organic food catalogue on dhatuorganics.com across 20+ categories: heritage rice (Rajamudi, red, black, brown Sonamasoori, brown/white Basmati, GABA germinated brown rice, red poha), millets and forgotten grains, sprouted/activated flours (ragi, jowar, bajra, moong, barnyard, brown top, foxtail, little millet, barley), cold-pressed oils and A2 bilona ghee, nut and seed butters (peanut, almond, coconut), spices (fermented turmeric, hing, black salt), natural sweeteners, ready-to-cook, beverages, malts and porridge, herbal supplements, fresh produce and country eggs, pickles, pulses. Site states incorporation in 2015 and that a production facility makes sprouted flours, cold-pressed oils, nut butters, fermented pickles and superfoods in-house; export operations are claimed from 2017. Rice is genuinely one of the lines (13 SKUs in the 'Rice is Life' collection), so the declared code is not fabricated — but it covers only a small slice of the portfolio.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — own production facility claimed for sprouted flours, cold-pressed oils, nut butters and fermented pickles (dhatuorganics.com/pages/about-us), plus a curated marketplace/organic retail and distribution arm sourcing from local organic farmers; also offers white labelling and franchise. No customs line was available to this researcher, so the manufacturing claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS 100630 is PARTIAL, not wrong: rice is a real, prominent product line (white Sonamasoori, white and brown Basmati, brown Sonamasoori, plus husked/unpolished red, black and Rajamudi rice which sit better under 100620). Per project rule 3 the company is kept and the code is corrected/expanded rather than rejected. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly correct but too narrow — this is an organic staples/health-food manufacturer-retailer, not a general FMCG trader. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: millets and millet flours (1008/1102), cereal flours and rava (1102), poha/flaked rice (1104), cold-pressed oils and castor oil (1513/1515), A2 cow ghee (0405), nut and seed butters (2008), spices including turmeric and hing (0910), salt (2501), sweeteners and laddus (1702/1704), ready-to-cook/beverages/malts/supplements (2106), fresh produce and eggs (0709/0810/0407), pickles (2001), pulses (0713). Trader signs: the About page describes the origin as 'a curated marketplace where local organic farmers and health-conscious consumers find each other', with third-party farm sourcing alongside own processing — so a mixed manufacturer/trader profile, and the declared single 6-digit code cannot represent it. All product and capability statements above come from the company's own website (dhatuorganics.com home, /collections/rice-is-life, /collections/all, /pages/about-us) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, B/L or shipping bill was reviewed by this researcher, and per role scope registries, revenue and shipment volumes were not investigated. The /pages/exports URL returned 404, so the export claim could not be read in detail. No public data on which specific SKUs are actually exported: null.
